caseNameFull: City of New York v. United States
attorneys: Mr. Thomas D. Thacher for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Shea, and Messrs. Sidney J. Kaplan, Paul A. Sweeney, and Robert L. Stern for the United States.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Murphy and Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
